privacyNotice.title: Privacy Notice
privacyNotice.subtitle: Configure the consent notice shown to widget visitors.
privacyNotice.policyUrlHint: Shown as a link in the widget consent banner. Leave empty to hide the link.
privacyNotice.invalidUrl: Enter a valid URL starting with http:// or https://.
privacyNotice.invalidVersion: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores (must start with a letter or digit, max 32).
privacyNotice.versionDefaultHint: Empty means the platform default version is in effect.
privacyNotice.versionWarning: Changing the version re-prompts every customer for consent. Their chat will show the notice again until they accept or decline.
privacyNotice.saveError: Failed to save privacy notice settings.

widgetBehavior.title: Widget behavior
widgetBehavior.desc: How the chat widget behaves on your storefront.
widgetBehavior.redirectHint: Clicking "Sign in" takes the shopper to the store's login page in the same tab; after signing in they return and the widget reopens on their orders.
widgetBehavior.popupHint: Clicking "Sign in" opens the store's login page in a popup window. Popup blockers may interfere; if the login stays on shopify.com the shopper must close the popup manually.
widgetBehavior.timezoneHint: Sets the widget's default language when the shopper hasn't chosen one — pick the zone your customers are in.
widgetBehavior.defaultLanguageHint: The language the widget starts in when the browser is English or unsupported. Leave it unset to derive it from the timezone; a language the shopper picks always wins. Applies to new widget sessions.
widgetBehavior.displayNameHint: Shown in the widget header and used as {shop} in greetings. Empty = tenant name.
widgetBehavior.firstVisitHint: Shown when a shopper opens the chat. {shop} inserts the display name. Empty = default message.
widgetBehavior.loginGreetingHint: Shown when a signed-in shopper is recognized. {name} inserts the customer's name. Empty = default message.
widgetBehavior.tabsHint: At least one tab must stay on. With Orders off, order filters (payment, shipping, reviews, inquiries) stay in the Notifications tab.
widgetBehavior.tabPositionHint: Top shows a text segmented bar under the title; bottom shows an icon-and-label bar pinned to the bottom of the widget.

shopify.title: Shopify connection
shopify.subtitle: The shop address and API token that bind this widget to your Shopify store.
shopify.accessTokenConfigured: Saved — enter a new token to replace

install.title: Install on your store
install.subtitle: Add the chat widget to your Shopify storefront. Pick the method that fits your setup.
install.shopHint: Snippets are filled in for your shop: {{shop}}
install.shopMissing: Save your shop domain above first so the snippets fill in automatically.
install.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the code and copy manually.

appEmbed.desc: No theme code editing, and easy to toggle on and off. Best for Online Store 2.0.
appEmbed.step1: In Shopify admin, open Online Store → Themes → Customize.

scriptTag.desc: Loads on every page via the Admin API. Registered automatically when the app is installed; use the request below to register it manually.
scriptTag.note: Send this with your Admin API access token. No theme edits required.

manual.desc: The simplest method — paste one snippet into your theme. No app required.
manual.step1: Open Online Store → Themes → ⋯ → Edit code.
manual.step3: Paste the snippet just before the </body> tag and Save.

shopify.nonShopifyDomain: This is not a *.myshopify.com domain. The field doubles as the tenant store domain, so a Cafe24 or custom domain here is fine — it just means this store is not connected to Shopify.

integrations.configured: Saved — enter a new value to replace

cafe24.title: Cafe24
cafe24.subtitle: Connect your Cafe24 store via the Admin API (OAuth access token).

woocommerce.title: WooCommerce
woocommerce.subtitle: Connect your WooCommerce store with REST API consumer keys.

odoo.title: Odoo
odoo.subtitle: Connect Odoo via the external API (URL, database, user, API key).
odoo.syncProductsHint: Pulls the Odoo catalogue into SharpTalk. After importing, register it as knowledge in the Knowledge menu to power widget product answers.

haravan.title: Haravan
haravan.subtitle: Connect your Haravan store with an Admin API access token.

klaviyo.title: Klaviyo
klaviyo.subtitle: Email/SMS marketing — connect with your private API key.

yotpo.title: Yotpo
yotpo.subtitle: Reviews & loyalty — connect with your app key and secret.

gorgias.title: Gorgias
gorgias.subtitle: Helpdesk — escalated chats can be handed off as Gorgias tickets.

integrations.syncHint: Import the catalogue/orders into SharpTalk. After importing products, register them as knowledge in the Knowledge menu to power widget product answers.

install.subtitle: Add the chat widget to your storefront. Pick your platform.

cafe24.desc: Paste the snippet into your Cafe24 theme HTML so the widget loads on every page.
cafe24.step1: In Cafe24 admin, open Design (PC/Mobile) → Smart Design edit.
cafe24.step2: Open the layout HTML of your default design.
cafe24.step3: Paste the snippet right before </body> and save/deploy.

woocommerce.desc: Register the widget from your WordPress theme (or a code-snippets plugin).
woocommerce.step1: In WordPress admin, open Appearance → Theme File Editor (child theme recommended).
woocommerce.step2: Open functions.php, or add a new snippet in a code-snippets plugin.
woocommerce.step3: Paste the code below and save — it loads via wp_footer on every page.

odoo.desc: Odoo websites can inject custom code site-wide from the website settings.
odoo.step1: In Odoo, open Website → Configuration → Settings.
odoo.step2: Scroll to the Custom Code section.
odoo.step3: Paste the snippet into the "end of body" field and save.

storefront.title: Storefront
storefront.hint: Used to verify product links before showing them to customers. Only links on this origin appear in chat.
storefront.unsetWarning: Not set — product recommendations will not appear as links in the chat widget.
storefront.shopDomainHint: Identifies this tenant to the chat widget. Any platform's domain — Shopify, Cafe24, or your own — as long as it matches the site the widget runs on.

oauth.title: Cafe24 (OAuth)
oauth.hint: Connect your Cafe24 mall via OAuth to pull its orders and products into SharpTalk.
oauth.productsSynced: {{synced}} product(s) synced, {{archived}} archived — run the conversion on the Knowledge page
oauth.errorInvalidScope: Cafe24 rejected the requested permissions (invalid_scope) — add them to the app in Cafe24 Developers, then connect again
oauth.errorAccessDenied: Cafe24 consent was denied (access_denied) — retry as the mall’s primary operator account

messenger.groupHint: Messages arrive in Live Chat and SharpTalk's AI answers on the same channel.
messenger.label: Display name
messenger.testRejected: Account rejected — the server answered, the email/password did not match. Use the provider’s own operator account, not your SharpTalk login. ({{detail}})
messenger.testNotFound: Server URL looks wrong — the address answered, but not with this provider’s API. ({{detail}})
messenger.testUnreachable: Could not reach the server — no answer at all. Check the address and whether the service is up. ({{detail}})
messenger.testProviderError: The provider returned an error — nothing to fix on this side; try again later. ({{detail}})
messenger.webhookRegistered: Receive URL registered with the provider.
messenger.webhookRegisterError: Could not register the receive URL.
messenger.webhookHint: Register it with the provider, or use the button below.
messenger.plannedHint: Not available in this build yet.
messenger.unofficialWarning: Unofficial channel: messages are relayed by an agent the merchant installs on their own device, and the merchant starts and stops it. AI auto-reply is off by default.

consent.notice: Send a privacy notice on first contact

ph.expected_customer: e.g. CUST-… (from the relay console; rejects a mispointed server)

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.subtitle: Direct — bot token, no platform review

amoebatalk.title: AmoebaTalk hub
amoebatalk.subtitle: Carries Zalo / LINE / WhatsApp with reviews already cleared

btbz_relay.title: btbz messenger relay
btbz_relay.subtitle: KakaoTalk rooms + inbound SMS via the merchant's own device

messenger.syncInactive: Fetched {{count}} message(s), but this channel is disabled — nothing will arrive on its own until you enable it.
messenger.inactiveWarning: Disabled — not receiving. Open Configure and set the channel to Enabled.
messenger.autoReplyScope: Applies to messages received from now on. Each conversation can override it in Live Chat.

mode.auto: Auto — the AI answers by itself
mode.approve: Needs approval — the AI drafts, an agent sends

menuAccess.title: Menu access
menuAccess.subtitle: Decide which console screens your team reaches. Greyed-out menus are not included in your plan.
menuAccess.masterNote: Master always reaches every menu your plan provides, so it cannot be locked out.
menuAccess.labelNote: Menus marked with a job label stay hidden from members without it. To open one for a single person regardless, use a member exception.
menuAccess.notProvidedNote: Struck-through menus are not provided by your plan; contact the platform admin to add them.
menuAccess.allowWaivesLabel: "Allow" also waives the job-label requirement for this member. Actions inside the screen still follow their rank and labels.

notifChannels.title: Notification channels
notifChannels.desc: Which notifications this shop may send, and by which route. Customers can still opt out of marketing within what you allow here.
notifChannels.hint: In-app is the widget notification feed and is always on.
notifChannels.unsetHint: Leave a row untouched and nothing changes — current behaviour continues.

widgetTabs.title: Widget tabs
widgetTabs.desc: Which tabs the chat widget shows, and where the tab bar sits.

widgetTheme.title: Widget theme
widgetTheme.desc: Apply your brand colour to the chat widget.
widgetTheme.brandHint: One colour is enough — the lighter and darker shades are generated from it.
widgetTheme.autoContrast: Text colour is chosen automatically so labels stay readable.
widgetTheme.statusFixed: Status colours (Confirmed, In Transit and so on) do not change — they carry meaning.
widgetTheme.saveError: Failed to save the widget theme.
widgetTheme.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP · up to 1MB · about 64px tall works best. SVG is not accepted.
widgetTheme.launcherHint: The floating button shoppers tap to open the widget.
widgetTheme.launcherModeTrigger: Storefront header trigger — your own element (e.g. a bell icon) opens the widget, docked under the header
widgetTheme.triggerHint: Add an opener element to your storefront header as in the example and put its selector in the snippet's trigger. The unread count shows in the data-sharptalk-badge element; the panel opens under the header on the right and closes on an outside click. If the element is not on the store, the widget falls back to the floating button automatically.
widgetTheme.fontHint: Base size scales text and spacing together (13–16 px). Uploaded fonts come from Design files; Noto Sans KR and Inter load from Google Fonts.
widgetTheme.panelHint: Desktop only — width {{wmin}}–{{wmax}}, height {{hmin}}–{{hmax}} px. Phones and app mode fill the screen.

embed.title: Embed & SDK
embed.description: Install the widget on your site, and let your own server tell it who is signed in.
embed.originsHint: The widget only loads on these domains. Leave empty to allow your store domain only.
embed.originsSaveError: Could not save the allowed domains
embed.secretHint: Your server signs a user id with this secret; the widget then recognises that user.
embed.rotateWarning: Signatures made with the current secret stop working immediately. Sign-in stays broken until your server is updated, and visitors show as guests.
embed.secretOnce: Copy it now — this value is not shown again.

aiEngines.title: AI engines
aiEngines.hint: An engine you register here is used before the platform engine. Pick which function uses which on the AI settings page.
aiEngines.platformHint: Managed by the operator of this service. Your own engine takes precedence over these.
aiEngines.empty: No engines of your own yet — the platform engines below are in use.
aiEngines.name: Name
aiEngines.endpointHint: Leave empty for the provider default.
aiEngines.apiKeyHint: Leave empty to keep the stored key.

testFail.auth: Authentication failed — check the API key
testFail.model: Model not found — check the model name
testFail.unreachable: Could not reach the provider — check the endpoint

aiEngines.billingNote: Calls made with your own key are billed to your account with that provider.
aiEngines.inUse: Still used by: {{functions}}. Point those functions elsewhere first.

aiUsage.title: AI usage
aiUsage.since: Counting since {{date}}. Anything before that was not measured.
aiUsage.noneYet: Nothing measured yet — counting starts with the next AI call.
aiUsage.stubNote: {{count}} call(s) fell back to the built-in stub: no tokens, and not a real answer.
aiUsage.noMoneyNote: Token counts only. Prices differ per model and change, so no cost is estimated here.

basic.subtitle: AI engines, storefront and agent handoff

widget.title: Widget settings
widget.subtitle: Theme, tabs, behaviour, embedding and install

etc.title: Other settings
etc.subtitle: Notifications, menu access and stored credentials

selfDev.title: Self-developed integration
selfDev.hint: For a store you built yourself. Send order and fulfilment events to the webhook below, signed with your secret.
selfDev.secretUnset: Not set — using the app-level secret
selfDev.replaceWarning: Saving replaces the secret immediately. Update the sending system in the same change, or its webhooks start failing.
selfDev.widgetPointer: For the widget itself, see Widget settings → Embed & SDK.

knowledgeOptions.title: Knowledge options
knowledgeOptions.usageGuidesHint: Manage how-to-use knowledge per product type. Useful for shops: when on, a “Usage guides” section appears on the Knowledge page. Turning it off hides the section only — written guides and their citations stay.

designAssets.title: Design files
designAssets.hint: Fonts, icons, images and reference documents kept in this tenant's own folder. They survive deployments and are what a custom widget design will point at. svg, css and js are not accepted.
designAssets.empty: No files of this kind yet
designAssets.fontLicense: You are responsible for the web-embedding licence of any font you upload.

rule.font: woff2 · ttf · otf, up to 2 MB
rule.icon: png · webp, up to 256 KB and 512×512
rule.image: png · jpg · webp, up to 2 MB and 2000 px
rule.doc: pdf · png · jpg, up to 10 MB (reference only)

error.E5081: Unsupported file for this kind — the content is checked, not the file name.
error.E5082: The file exceeds the size limit for its kind.
error.E5083: The image exceeds the pixel limit for its kind.
error.E5084: Design-file quota is full — delete something first.

widgetDesigns.title: Custom widgets
widgetDesigns.revertConfirm: Switch the storefront back to the basic widget?
widgetDesigns.hint: Build named designs (font, size, corners, panel size, launcher icon) and keep them here. Pick one with “Use” — it goes live immediately, no deployment. With none in use, shoppers see the basic widget.
widgetDesigns.name: Name
widgetDesigns.editLiveConfirm: This design is in use — saving changes the storefront immediately. Continue? (Tip: duplicate first to edit safely.)
widgetDesigns.editorPreviewHint: Static preview. “Preview” on a saved design opens the real widget.
widgetDesigns.previewHint: Loaded with a 10-minute preview token. Shoppers are not affected.
widgetDesigns.previewNoShop: Set the shop domain first (Storefront settings).

done.apply: Custom widget is now in use

error.E5086: This design is in use — switch to the basic widget or another design first.
error.E5087: A design with this name already exists.

widgetDesigns.customCssHint: Only stable classes: .st-panel .st-header .st-header-title .st-tabs .st-tab .st-message .st-message-user .st-message-bot .st-composer .st-input .st-send .st-launcher .st-quick-reply. Colours, fonts, spacing, borders and shadows only; layout, hiding and url() are dropped.
widgetDesigns.reviewLinkHint: Where "Write a review" in the widget's Review tab goes. Empty = the product page. Use {productUrl}#reviews to jump to your review app's section, or a full https:// URL containing {productUrl}.
widgetDesigns.historyEmpty: No earlier versions yet (a snapshot is taken on every edit)

settingsSnapshots.title: Settings snapshots
settingsSnapshots.hint: Saves the widget theme, copy, tabs, sign-in mode, notification channels, embed origins, knowledge options, timezone, storefront, privacy notice and the custom-widget library as one JSON file in this tenant's folder. It survives deployments and can be restored here or moved to another environment.
settingsSnapshots.noSecrets: Integration credentials and the embed secret are never included.
settingsSnapshots.diffHint: Snapshot taken {{at}}. Highlighted rows will change. Restoring is audited.
settingsSnapshots.designsLine: Custom widgets: {{create}} to create, {{update}} to update · in use after restore: {{active}}
